We need number of carbonyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no SMILES given. We need to infer from NMR or IR. Carbonyl groups show IR C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1. So we can get IR spectra using tool ir_spectra. That will give peaks. Then count carbonyl peaks. Usually each carbonyl gives a strong peak around 1700-1750. Could be overlapping. Use IR.

We should call ir_spectra.
